facts.value: The state glass guild's 2026 member directory lists 46 glassblowing studios, each with a published owner email; none has been offered the pack yet; each needs at most one a year.
Sell Brain produces and delivers the pack on payment; card payouts land 3 days after payment. A studio needs one pack a year. to each buyer.
Nine studio owners in a neighbouring state's guild paid $240 each for the pack after one email (payment-processor report, Nov 2026).

reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is supported. One opening, every chain link established on the card's EVIDENCE facts: 46 reachable guild studios with published owner emails (none offered, one pack/year each), a dated buying signal (2026-11-25), a real purchase price ($240 paid by 9 studio owners for this same pack, payment-processor report), conversion measured on this offer's own sales (9 of 20 = 45%), fulfilment by Brain (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $4 direct cost, $0 exposure, 3-day card settlement. Recomputed: 9 x $240 = $2,160 >= $2,000; 9/46 = 19.6% needed vs 45% measured (even the ~27% lower 90% bound of 9/20 gives an expected ~12 deals); cost $36 paid from receipts after payment, so no up-front capital and minimum cash never below 0; paid day 7, settled day 10, inside 30 days. Ledger matches the steps (receipt on collect, $36 spend on deliver day 10). Owner hours ~0.1 per order, no hours cap set.
findings: Recomputed target: 9 x 240 = 2160 USD settled by day 10 of 30; net 2124 after the 36 USD direct cost.
Required conversion 9/46 = 19.6% vs measured 9/20 = 45%; margin holds even at the lower confidence bound of a 20-contact sample.

Price and conversion were measured in a neighbouring state's guild; same pack and same buyer type, so it transfers, but geography is not identical (scope: population MATCH, geography MISMATCH but immaterial given the margin).

Operational note, not an evidence gap: SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED and DISCOVER_LOCAL_BUSINESSES is UNREAD; the reach and collect steps need those connectors working before day 1.
Delivery is scheduled day 10, three days after payment on day 7, while the offer says delivery on payment; harmless to the cash, but delivery could be day 7.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance for the changed contract ($15,000 settled in 30 days, no capital). The only opening's links all hold except volume: its EVIDENCE buyerVolume fact counts 46 studios in the state guild directory, each needing at most one pack a year, at the evidenced $240 purchase price. Recomputed: ceiling 46 x $240 = $11,040 < $15,000; the target needs ceil(15,000/240) = 63 sales, 17 more buyers than exist in the counted market; at the measured 45% conversion the expected take is ~21 sales = ~$4,970. This is a constraint on the held opening (even every buyer buying cannot fit), and the decisive link MARKET_VOLUME and the TARGET constraint (<= $11,040) are grounded on the buyerVolume and price fields. The resolution correctly separates what is not yet evidenced (studios in other guild directories) from what is known, and does not count uncounted markets.
findings: Recomputed: 46 x $240 = $11,040 max; 63 sales needed for $15,000; expected ~$4,970 at 45%.
Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis says '50 deal(s) needed'; at $240 the count is 63 (62.5 rounded up). The verdict is the same either way.
Other guilds' studios are uncounted, not ruled out: the research step to count them is the right next action; nothing uncounted is treated as known.
